I'll help you get that information. Let me pull up the manual to find the right function for querying agents by currency.{{READ:account_lookup}}

context_diary: The account_lookup class provides a lookup_account function that can filter by account type (AGENT, USER, ADMIN) and currency, with configurable return fields and result limits. The system defaults to limiting results to prevent overload, showing total match counts when limits are applied. This pattern of filtering by type and attributes with field selection appears to be a standard query approach across the platform.
